_source: Our own table: the site rules of power (docs/eras/ev.md, Moon rules and Mars rules). Dimension ids: vanilla, the pack's datapack (grindless:void, grindless:flat) and Gregicality Rocketry 0.2.9 (see planets.json).
_how_it_is_used: Read by server_scripts/grindless/power/generators.js (published as global.grindless.power.site) and the smoke test gg_test_mars_site.js.

A fuel needs air to burn. Every recipe of burningTypes gets one dimension condition per entry of airDimensions. GTM ORs the dimension conditions of a recipe (DimensionCondition.isOr in GTM 7.5.3), so the fuel burns in any of those dimensions and nowhere else: not on the Moon, on Mars, in any orbit or on any planet added later. Reversed conditions cannot say 'not the Moon and not Mars': ORed, they pass everywhere.

airDimensions are the dimensions of Earth in planets.json without its orbit: they have breathable air. A new dimension with air (from a new mod) has to be added here, or nothing burns in it. Their order is the order of the conditions: GTM's recipe view (GTRecipeWidget) draws every dimension marker of a recipe at the same spot, so only the last one shows in EMI. The Overworld goes last (the building dimensions have no marker and would show as a barrier).

burnAnywhere: fuels that carry their own oxidizer, and lava, which heats a boiler without burning. Their recipes get no condition. A recipe matches when one of its fluid inputs is the fluid or its forge: tag (for example forge:lava).

newFuels: fuel recipes of ours. gtmDuration is the duration GTM would give the recipe; generators.js doubles it like every other generator recipe (DECISIONS.md, power pass), so the EU per mB matches the rest. They are made with no condition: they burn anywhere.
A recipe that already carries a dimension condition is left alone: it was placed on purpose.

burnAnywhere.why: methane premixed with its oxygen (ev/foundation.js): the fuel of the Moon and Mars
GTM's rocket fuel: dimethylhydrazine mixed with oxygen or dinitrogen tetroxide
GT--: methylhydrazine mixed with nitric acid
lava heats a boiler without burning

newFuels.name: methalox
newFuels.why: 6 mB of methalox hold 2 mB of methane (CH4 + 2 O2), the amount of GTM's methane recipe (2 mB, 7 ticks, 32 EU/t): the same EU per mB of methane, 224 EU after the doubling, about 74.7 EU per mB of methalox. Mixing costs 12.8 EU per mB of methalox (ev/foundation.js), the price of carrying the oxygen.
